implementation: Independent HPE adaptation of the published ANP mechanism; no new defense algorithm or exact CIFAR reproduction is claimed.

paper.title: Adversarial Neuron Pruning Purifies Backdoored Deep Models

official_repository.licensing_note: No repository LICENSE file was found at this inspected commit. Source is linked for attribution and mechanism verification, not vendored or represented as granting a license.

default_configuration_source.sha256_encoding: Exact downloaded raw file bytes, SHA256; not a reserialized YAML/JSON digest.

mechanism_preserved: Frozen ordinary model weights; train multiplicative BN scale masks and adversarial scale/bias perturbations on a disposable copy.
Noise starts uniformly in [-eps,eps], followed by signed ascent. Upstream does not project the updated noise; only masks are clamped to [0,1].
Natural/adversarial loss mixture weighted by alpha and 1-alpha, respectively.
Round mask scores to four decimal places, then threshold them as in the upstream saved-score pruning path.
Prune original victim BN gamma only; leave beta, ordinary weights and original running statistics unchanged. No extra post-pruning fine-tuning.
declared_adaptations: HPELi CSI-to-pose backbone instead of an image classifier; MPJPE instead of cross-entropy; both ordinary affine BN1d and BN2d are handled.
BackdoorBench YAML scalar defaults are used rather than the official repository's separate CIFAR command-line learning rate/batch defaults. This is not a line-for-line BackdoorBench execution.
Shared trusted clean original TRAIN bank capped at 5%, split approximately 80/20 by sequence into repair-fit and repair-selection; original victim may have seen this bank.

Replace BackdoorBench's TEST-ASR-driven checkpoint/pruning selection with the greatest fixed-grid threshold that keeps held-out clean TRAIN MPJPE within 10% relative to the unpruned victim. An explicit unpruned identity fallback is retained; every candidate and its score are saved.
Fit batches use uniform replacement sampling with a separately checkpointed torch generator; deterministic workers=0. No claim of identical CIFAR minibatch RNG trajectories.
Atomic checkpoints every 25 mask iterations and after each pruning candidate include optimizer, sampler, RNG and binding states. An interruption can replay at most 24 uncheckpointed mask iterations.

evaluation.dataset: MM-Fi protocol1-s1, full official TRAIN/TEST, seeds 42/43/44
evaluation.victim: Existing frozen A1 rho=.1 checkpoint, 50 epochs; never retrained by this defense runner
evaluation.validation_status: Local synthetic/unit validation only until an independently audited full MM-Fi GPU run is supplied.
evaluation.limitations: Unequal native repair budgets across defenses are declared, not compute-matched. No claim of optimized HPE parameters, universal defense resistance or statistical superiority.
